column1: # Enumerates configuration positions outside rules: from ConfigSchema, closed-subtree probes, and check-command CLI doors.
# Unknown-key refusal makes a subtree ENUMERATED; silence leaves it UNENUMERATED. This measures accepted shape, not downstream effect.
# Probes cover nesting to depth four and the check command only. Presets share the YAML loader; composer.json path injection is not measured.
# Normalization policy belongs to the root. List element shape is recorded separately from container shape.
# Columns: path, YAML spelling, door, CLI option, owner, shape declaration, closed probe, element shape, normalization policy, status, removed confounder, note.
